description.text:
We are looking for a Python Developer with strong backend development, system design, and cloud experience. This role will be responsible for developing backend services and working closely with AI engineers to transform AI models and research outcomes into reliable, maintainable, observable, and production-ready products.
1.Develop and maintain backend services, APIs, and business features using Python.
2.Participate in system architecture and technical solution design, with a focus on
scalability, reliability, security, and operational costs.
3.Collaborate with AI, data, and product teams to integrate AI models and
capabilities into production products.
4.Productize AI engineers’ PoCs and research outcomes, including API design, i
nference services, data pipelines, error handling, testing, and deployment.
5.Build monitoring, logging, alerting, version management, and incident-tracking
mechanisms.
6.Establish and improve CI/CD, automated testing, deployment, and rollback
processes.
7.Analyze and optimize system performance, reliability, and cloud costs.
8.Write system design documents, technical documentation, and operational
runbooks.
9.Participate in production incident response, root-cause analysis, and post-incident
improvements.

key_values.label: 其他條件
key_values.text:
1.3+ years of professional Python development experience.
2.Proficiency with Python web frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, or Flask.
3.Experience developing RESTful APIs, microservices, or backend systems.
4.Strong system design skills, including service decomposition, database design,
asynchronous processing, queues, or event-driven architectures.
5.Experience with cloud development or deployment; GCP experience is highly
preferred.
6.Familiarity with Docker, Linux, Git, and CI/CD practices.
7.Experience with automated testing and a strong focus on code quality and
maintainability.
8.Ability to collaborate with AI engineers and turn research outcomes into reliable
production services.
9.Strong problem-solving, communication, and technical documentation skills.
Nice to Have
1.Experience with GCP services such as Cloud Run, GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL,
BigQuery, or Vertex AI.
2.Experience with Kubernetes, Terraform, or Infrastructure as Code.
3.Experience with MLOps, model deployment, model monitoring, or AI inference
services.
4.Familiarity with Redis, PostgreSQL, message queues, or observability tools.
5.Experience building large-scale, distributed, or high-traffic systems.
6.Knowledge of security, access control, data privacy, and cloud cost management.
